download_s2ef_data: download and preprocess the S2EF dataset for a specified split like 200k or val_id
download_is2re_data: download and extract the IS2RE dataset for molecular conformation tasks
run_get_data: run the get_data function to download a task dataset to a specified directory
verify_s2ef_count: verify the S2EF dataset split count matches expected values after preprocessing
cleanup_intermediate_files: cleanup intermediate tar files and directories after data download and extraction
